exposure: time since steroid injection (<14 days vs >14 days)
cohort: Preterm twins (28-34 weeks gestation) born within and after 14 days of completion of a single course of antenatal steroids.
finding: A steroid-delivery interval of more than 14 days was associated with a significantly increased risk of neonatal death (adjusted relative risk of 2).
birth_weight: Varied; birth weight <1.5kg associated with respiratory and other morbidities, <1kg associated with neonatal death
